EXT_Description.message: Send playback information from authorized websites to the TaskbarLyrics desktop app.

EXT_Help.message: Manage websites and priority in the desktop app. The browser confirms access. Playback data goes only to this computer; lyric searches follow desktop settings.

EXT_Disconnected.message: Disconnected. Start the desktop app and set up the extension.

EXT_Sent.message: Sent to desktop app. Make sure browser recognition is enabled.
